_note: 寫作（writing）島 sidecar：一頁多單元。strand=writing。本批 3 個單元覆蓋 5 個知識點：W1 照著抄寫與仿寫（copy-imitate，t_base）；W2 造完整句＋大小寫與標點（sentence-making／punctuation-caps，t_mid）；W3 看圖寫句＋寫簡單信/email（picture-basic／letter-email，t_mid）。英語島治理：語感＞文法、英文學英文（R14＝teach 的 body 全英文零 CJK，中文對照放 zh_hint、預設收合），國小高年級／TOEIC 600-750 可讀的簡單英文，不教台式對比。寫作無法自動批改，故每單元用兩種 practice 混合：(1) 客觀子技能 MCQ（type:mcq、validation_method:expert）測寫作的可客觀判定子技能（句子抄得對不對、是不是完整句、大小寫標點對不對、email 署名放哪裡、哪一句正確描述了圖），有唯一正解、綁 answer_evidence 指向本單元 claims、每個錯項附 distractor_rationales，這類題承載 rubric⑦ 真教真考；(2) 自評產出題（type:writing、validation_method:self）要學生自己寫（抄寫／仿寫／造句／看圖寫一句／寫問候），題目在 answer 欄給明確 model answer／範例，絕不假裝自動批改手寫作文，selfeval_note 要學生對照範例自己判斷（寫對意思即可、用字不必一字不差）→SRS。看圖題的圖內容一律用英文文字描述放在 stem。每個宣告的知識點都在某 teach 段與某 MCQ 的 kp_ids 出現（rubric⑦ 綁定成立，不依賴自評題）。英文示範句／標點／格式／model answer 皆以 Cambridge English 等權威查證、status:provisional、risk_class:normal、待英語母語 reviewer 複核。學習者端零年段字樣。（由 english_writing.units.json 拆出的單一單元新引擎頁，內容沿用；HD 2026-11-03 新版可重用舊 material）

units.title_zh: 中譯英＋寫出自然英文（translate into natural English）
units.can_do: 我能把簡單的中文句子翻成自然的英文，先懂整句意思再用英文說，而不是一字一字直譯，寫出道地、不彆扭的英文。
units.situation_group: 寫作：中譯英與自然英文
units.subject: eng

claims.text: When you translate a Chinese sentence into English, express the meaning, not each word. First understand the whole meaning, then say it the way an English speaker would. A word-by-word translation often sounds strange.
claims.verification_ref: 把中文句翻成英文時，要翻『意思』而不是逐字翻；先懂整句意思，再用英語母語者的說法說出來；逐字直譯常聽起來彆扭；屬翻譯與英語表達通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Some everyday Chinese phrases use a different verb in natural English. The idea of '開燈' is said as 'turn on the light', and '坐公車' is said as 'take the bus'. Natural English uses these set phrases, so a word-by-word version like 'open the light' sounds strange.
claims.verification_ref: 一些日常中文說法在自然英文裡用不同的動詞：『開燈』說 turn on the light、『坐公車』說 take the bus；道地英文用這些固定說法，逐字直譯成 open the light 聽起來彆扭；屬英語搭配／片語通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: In English you use only one connecting word where Chinese may use a pair. '雖然…但是…' becomes just 'Although ..., ...' with no extra 'but', and '因為…所以…' becomes just 'Because ..., ...' with no extra 'so'. Adding the second connector is not natural English.
claims.verification_ref: 英文在中文用成對連接詞的地方只用一個：『雖然…但是…』只用 Although …, …（後半不再加 but）、『因為…所以…』只用 Because …, …（後半不再加 so）；多加第二個連接詞不是自然英文；屬英語連接詞用法通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: When you translate a sentence into English, translate the meaning, not each separate word. First read the whole sentence and make sure you understand it. Then say the same idea the way an English speaker would. For example, the idea of walking to school every day is simply 'I walk to school every day.' If you move the words one by one in Chinese order, the English can sound strange, so always check that your English sentence sounds natural.
teach.zh_hint: 把句子翻成英文時，翻的是『意思』，不是一個一個字。先讀完整句、確定你懂它的意思。然後用英語母語者的說法把同樣的意思說出來。例如「每天走路上學」這個意思，英文就是 'I walk to school every day.'。如果照中文語序一字一字搬，英文會聽起來彆扭，所以要檢查你的英文句子是不是自然。

teach.body: Natural English sometimes uses different words from a word-by-word translation. For the idea of switching on a light, English says 'turn on the light', and for riding a bus, English says 'take the bus'. Also, English uses only one connecting word where another language may use a pair: the idea of 'although ... but ...' is just 'Although ..., ...' in English, with no extra 'but'. Learning these natural phrases helps your English sound clear and real.
teach.zh_hint: 自然的英文有時用的字和逐字翻不同。「開燈」這個意思，英文說 'turn on the light'；「坐公車」英文說 'take the bus'。另外，中文用成對連接詞的地方英文只用一個：『雖然…但是…』英文只用 'Although ..., ...'，後半不再加 but。學會這些道地說法，你的英文會更清楚、更自然。

teach.body: Compare a word-by-word version with natural English. Idea 1 (turning on the light): word-by-word 'open the light' sounds strange; natural English is 'Please turn on the light.' Idea 2 (although it rained): a double connector 'Although it rained, but we went out.' is not natural; natural English is 'Although it rained, we still went out.' A word-by-word translation is often not the natural way to say it in English.
teach.zh_hint: 比較逐字版和自然英文。意思一（開燈）：逐字版 'open the light' 聽起來彆扭；自然英文是 'Please turn on the light.'。意思二（雖然下雨）：用成對連接詞 'Although it rained, but we went out.' 不自然；自然英文是 'Although it rained, we still went out.'。逐字直譯常常不是英文裡自然的說法。

teach.body: Your turn: translate the Chinese sentence in the hint into natural English (translate the meaning, not word by word). Example answer: I go to school by bus every day.
teach.zh_hint: 換你做：把下面這句中文翻成自然的英文（翻意思、不要逐字翻）——「我每天坐公車上學。」。對照範例自評（不自動批改）：翻出意思、用自然說法（例如 take the bus／by bus）、整句通順即可（用字可不同）。範例：I go to school by bus every day.。

teach.body: Your turn: make this sentence sound like natural English by using only one connector — 'Although I was tired, but I finished my homework.' Example answer: Although I was tired, I finished my homework.
teach.zh_hint: 換你做：把這句改成自然英文，只用一個連接詞——'Although I was tired, but I finished my homework.'。對照範例自評（不自動批改）：拿掉多餘的 but、只留 Although 即可。正解：Although I was tired, I finished my homework.。

practice.stem: 下面這句中文「我每天走路上學。」最自然的英文說法是哪一個？
practice.answer: I walk to school every day.
options: I walk to school every day.
I every day walk to school.
I am walk to school every day.
I walk to go to school every day.

把「每天」照中文語序硬塞在主詞後面，英文語序不自然（every day 一般放句尾）。
am 後面不能直接接原形動詞 walk，文法錯誤。
多了 'to go'，是把「走路去上學」逐字直譯的彆扭說法。

practice.feedback: 翻意思、用自然語序：'I walk to school every day.'——每天（every day）放句尾才自然。

practice.stem: 「請開燈。」最自然、道地的英文是哪一個？

把「開」逐字翻成 open，英文不這樣說燈；道地說法是 turn on the light。
同樣把「開」直譯成 open，open the lamp 也不是自然英文。
give the light 意思不通，不是「開燈」的說法。

practice.feedback: 「開燈」道地的英文用 turn on：'Please turn on the light.'；逐字翻成 open the light 不自然。

practice.stem: 下面哪一句是自然、正確的英文（連接詞沒有多餘）？
practice.answer: Although it was raining, we still went out.
options: Although it was raining, we still went out.
Although it was raining, but we still went out.
Although it was raining, so we still went out.
Although raining, we still went out.

distractor_rationales.Although it was raining, but we still we: 把『雖然…但是…』逐字搬過來，用了 Although 又加 but；英文只用一個連接詞。
distractor_rationales.Although it was raining, so we still wen: Although 後面不該再配 so；而且 so 表結果，意思也不對，英文只用一個連接詞。
漏了 'it was'，Although 後面要接完整的主詞和動詞。

practice.feedback: 英文只用一個連接詞：'Although it was raining, we still went out.'——用了 Although 就不再加 but 或 so。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案／範例自己判斷（不自動批改手寫作答）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 朗讀檢查（不產音檔、不自動判讀）：把你翻好／改好的英文句子出聲讀一遍，一邊讀一邊感覺『這樣說自不自然』『有沒有多餘的連接詞或逐字直譯的彆扭』。

lines.text: I walk to school every day.
Although it was raining, we still went out.
